title: Add harness arms F, F-rand, A-c and A-c+F and pass offline end to end (S0)
description:
## Purpose

Add arms F, F-rand, A-c and A-c+F to the unified harness and run every arm offline end to end on the fake Jev.

## Scope

- **Request shape (owner, Q2):** one Jev request per item with the example list in the state together with every rubric question; the answer cache key includes the list fingerprint.
- **F:** each round: predict the new labels, `improve_example_list` (k = 4 per label + 1 reserve; incumbent, hard-demo swap, random control; incumbent keeps ties) against the labels so far, answer labels and dev-100 with the chosen list, refit the head on those answers.
- **F-rand:** `RandomBalanced` fixed list redrawn each round (independent seed), same k (the control).
- **A-c:** arm A with comments passed through `_record_feedback` (`edit_comment_value`); runs as A until a labeler supplies comments.
- **A-c+F:** A-c's steering plus F's list optimization over its own question set.
- New spend ledger with a **cumulative ceiling of 7,500 Jev requests**; dev-100 and paper-600 always in `protected_ids`.

## Definition of done

Specs first, no network: offline run of all arms with `FakeJevCore` passes; ceiling enforced; protected IDs never enter lists or development; F and F-rand fingerprints differ. `make test` green. **Stop S0. Cost: $0.**

## Design

[DECISION_FLYWHEEL_DESIGN.md](https://github.com/AnthusAI/Decision-Flywheel-Evaluations/blob/main/studies/DECISION_FLYWHEEL_DESIGN.md) §1.3, §3.2, §5.2, §6 step 3.

## Companion-project coordination

- [Decision-Flywheel](https://github.com/AnthusAI/Decision-Flywheel/tree/main/project/issues): `decision-flywheel-886c718d-c0f7-4384-81e9-7ad29677be98`.
- [Decision-Flywheel](https://github.com/AnthusAI/Decision-Flywheel/tree/main/project/issues): `decision-flywheel-1dc7a4b2-61d5-48ab-962e-22a55ffa6a39`.

These are cross-repository references; local Kanbus blocked-by relationships encode prerequisites within this repository.
